259:t_2:47.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「We can't make another hyperspace jump for a while! What are we supposed to do!?」

259:t_2:48.en:
$$ボス$$
「W-what are we supposed to do...? You...」

259:t_2:51.en:
$$甲児$$
「Where there's hope, light is born... Right now, we have to believe that and press on.」

259:t_2:54.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't you want to join everyone?」

259:t_2:59.en:
$n
「That voice that interfered with $$ゼウス$$'s teleportation... Ever since I heard it, my eyes...」

259:t_2:60.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Those are the $$血塗られた眼$$... Then was that voice the 《$$テンシ$$》 you were chasing, $n?」

259:t_10:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Hardly... Even I understand how serious this is.」

259:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Really? I sensed a great surge of emotion when you racked up your score against the $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

259:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It produced 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$. I'll add them to the team's stock.」

259:t_10:7.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Do as you like. I'm not particularly interested.」

259:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Now then, $$ニコラ$$... Judging by your emotions, you are, to put it bluntly...」

259:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're aiming to surpass $$ラルク$$ and take the top spot! You want everyone to call you the Prince!」

259:t_10:12.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「You caught me... That's actually right.」

259:t_10:13.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Don't tell the Princess about this. See you...」

259:t_10:15.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Don't sit there feeling pleased with yourself, $$ＡＧ$$.」

259:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But, $$カシオ$$... I've reached a tentative conclusion in the background investigation of $$ニコラ$$ you requested.」

259:t_10:17.en:
$$カシオ$$
「...I heard you were sensitive to human emotions, but you seem pretty blind to them.」

259:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How rude! Whatever else I may be, I'm a robot. You should say my sensors aren't sensitive enough!」

259:t_10:19.en:
$$カシオ$$
「...Never mind. We're at the far end of space, anyway. $$ニコラ$$ probably can't make a move.」

259:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What exactly concerns you about $$ニコラ$$, $$カシオ$$?」

259:t_10:21.en:
$$カシオ$$
「...Forget it. I'm probably worrying over nothing...」

259:t_10:22.en:
$$カシオ$$
(Rumor has it he's involved with those strange people on $$タイタン$$... What could $$ニコラ$$ want with those sisters...)

259:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're worried about $$ゼウス$$, aren't you, $$甲児$$?」

259:t_10:29.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$ is the god of light. I believe he'll be fine, whatever happens.」

259:t_10:30.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm thinking about the difference between humans and gods.」

259:t_10:32.en:
$$甲児$$
「When Grandpa entrusted $$マジンガーＺ$$ to me, he said its power could make me a god or a demon...」

259:t_10:33.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$マジンガー$$'s power can certainly fight the self-proclaimed gods of $$ミケーネ$$ on equal terms. But...」

259:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You still doubt that this makes you a god yourself, then.」

259:t_10:35.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah... I don't think their idea of a god simply means a being with tremendous power.」

259:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see... You sense a difference in kind, rather than in degree.」

259:t_10:37.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... You're a dimensional merchant. Don't you know anything?」

259:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm just a humble agent robot, so I have nothing to say on that, but...」

259:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've heard that $$Ｚチップ$$ are the power that lets humans perform divine miracles.」

259:t_10:41.en:
$$甲児$$
「Come to think of it, during the $$時獄戦役$$... I once used $$Ｚチップ$$ to bring $$ゼウス$$ back from between dimensions.」

259:t_10:45.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$Ｚチップ$$ turn feelings into power... Feelings bring about miracles... That's enough for me right now.」

259:t_10:46.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then allow me to show you how my feelings bring about a miracle.」

259:t_10:48.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The calls I make to draw in customers every day... Those express my feelings. In other words, a customer's arrival is a miracle!」

259:t_10:49.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here we go!! Today, too! With all my energy! Business, busineeeess!!」

259:t_10:53.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n has collapsed with a high fever. Please stop shouting like an idiot.」

259:t_10:55.en:
$$甲児$$
「...You've got a long way to go to godhood, $$ＡＧ$$.」

259:t_10:56.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not really. I'm always waiting for gods.」

259:t_10:58.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After all, the customer is a god.」

260:t_000:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Thank you for your efforts, $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ and $$號$$.」

260:t_000:3.en:
$$凱$$
「For a hyperspace jump, the view hasn't changed much...」

260:t_000:7.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Then, since it's 28,000 light-years from the galactic center to Earth...」

260:t_000:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll have to do the same thing 35,000 times.」
